text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You've certainly put in quite the 
effort. We've prepared more than enough in 
return for our juniors, though."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... to think such talent lay dormant 
within you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether this is rare focus or an 
expression of zeal... Perhaps I should 
reconsider my evaluation a little—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, perhaps I should save that for when I 
display brilliant handling in my Trainer 
duties.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Naturally, you'll be giving your 
all in our main duties as well, right?
